name: stay-length
title: Stay Length
description: Catches off-by-one bookings and leave requests by reading the range back as "Mon 2 Nov – Sun 8 Nov · 6 nights, 7 days" and flagging an end before the start, nights confused with days, a check-out that may really be the last night, and weekends or pluggable holidays that change how much leave it costs, each with a one-tap fix.
